main_text.p: quod צלהב per commutationem י & ש. Sunt autem quadrata ex להב. Ithpah. אשתלהב Comburi, Exod. 32. 1. in Jonath.
שלהובא Chaldaicè, Flamma. Syrè, שלהוב, Lucæ 16.24. Plur. שלהובין, Jesa.13.8.

שלהי Ch. Fessum, defessum, lassum esse: Item defatigare, defessum facere vel reddere, Jesa. 32.6. Ithpah. אשתלהי Moleste, ægre ferre, defessus fieri, fatigari, defatigari, defatigare se, defetisci, deficere animo vel anhelitu, præ nimia fatigatione, deliquium pati. Quadratum ex להה.
משלהי Chal. Defessus, fessus, lassus, defatigatus. Plural. משלהין 2. Sam. 17. 29. Fœminin. משלהתא & משלהיא Fessa: & metaphoricè per catachresin, Sitibunda, Proverb. 25.25.
שלהוי Ch. Idem, Jesa. 8.22. Guido reddit, Anxietates.
אשתלהיות Chal. Deliquium, tristitia, anxietas, Psalm. 61.3. Jon. 2.8.
שלהיא Ch. מן שליא Idem quod מן שליא Subitò, ex improviso, derepente, Jobi 30.6.
שלין Ch. Coturnix. Scribitur promiscuè cum ש, & ס.

שלח Ch. & Syr. Mittere, emittere, dimittere, ablegare: Item Exuere, extrahere, nudare, denudare, spoliare. Pahel שלח Idem. Syr. Pret. cum Aff. Spoliârunt eum, Lucæ 10.30. Aphel אשלח Idem. Ithpah. אשתלח. Mitti, emitti, immitti, deferri.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are rendered as closely as the scan allows; several vocalised forms and Syriac letters are uncertain and may contain errors. The Hebrew glyphs in the Chaldee/Syriac entries are approximate.
